rules.description: Applicant or their partner must be aged 75 or over
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be aged 75 or over to qualify for a free TV licence

rules.description: The 75+ person or their partner must receive Pension Credit
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be receiving Pension Credit to qualify for a free TV licence. If you think you're eligible for Pension Credit, apply first.

rules.description: The Pension Credit claimant must be the 75+ person or their partner
rules.reason_if_failed: The person aged 75+ or their partner must be the Pension Credit claimant to qualify

rules.description: Applicant must be a UK resident requiring a TV licence
rules.reason_if_failed: This concession is only available for UK TV licence holders

edge_cases.description: Pension Credit application is pending decision
edge_cases.action: Inform applicant to complete Pension Credit application first. Free TV licence can be backdated if Pension Credit is awarded.

edge_cases.description: Applicant lives in a care home
edge_cases.action: Different rules apply for care homes. Hand off to TV Licensing specialist team for accommodation licensing rules.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is moving house during application
edge_cases.action: Complete application with current address. Contact TV Licensing to update address when move is confirmed.
Only one free licence needed per household. Confirm who the licence holder should be.
